name: ZexoCard Everyday Virtual Card
summary: ZexoCard is a reloadable virtual card you fund with crypto such as USDT, USDC, Bitcoin, Ethereum or Solana, with no routine ID check for standard sign-up. The Everyday card costs US$10 to issue, charges US$0.25 per purchase and works with Apple Pay and Google Pay; a separate subscription card for AI, advertising and cloud services has no per-purchase fee.

kyc.notes: Standard onboarding needs only an email sign-up, with no routine identity-document submission. Country restrictions still apply.

faq.question: How much does the ZexoCard Everyday Virtual Card cost?
faq.answer: US$10 one-time issuance, with no monthly fee. Every purchase with the Everyday card costs US$0.25, deducted from the card balance. Funding fees are shown in your quote before you pay.

faq.question: Does ZexoCard require KYC?
faq.answer: Standard onboarding needs only an email and no routine identity-document submission. Country restrictions still apply.

faq.question: What are ZexoCard's limits?
faq.answer: Up to US$100,000 per transaction and US$500,000 per calendar month per card, with no separate daily cap. The card balance must cover the payment plus fees.

faq.question: Does ZexoCard work with Apple Pay and Google Pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The Everyday card can be added to Apple Pay or Google Pay on eligible devices.

faq.question: What is the ZexoCard subscription card?
faq.answer: A card for supported AI, advertising and cloud merchants. It has no per-purchase merchant fee and can be topped up at any time.

availabilityNotes: ZexoCard says country restrictions apply but does not publish which countries are supported or restricted. Check during sign-up before funding a card.
howToGet: Sign up on zexocard.com with your email.
Fund your ZexoCard wallet with crypto such as USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH or SOL.
Choose the Everyday card (or the Subscription card for AI, ads and cloud services) and pay the US$10 issuance fee.
Check the quote: the funding fee is shown before you confirm.
Top up the card from your wallet and add it to Apple Pay or Google Pay.
